title: midday-scrapbook-quick-todo-and-brain-dump
body:
Quick brain dump (midday). Not polished — just capture before I forget.

MORNING:
- standup: call out perf test flakiness on r-infer/serve (batcher timeout spikes around 95th pctl) — add ticket.
- Follow up w/ Liam on vanity metrics for onboarding funnel (conversion by template).

TODOS (short):
- [ ] file expense for conference taxi (receipt photo on phone).
- [ ] buy headphones cable (3.5mm to USB-C) — order tonight Amazon Prime.
- [ ] push small DX PR: fix typo in quickstart README (link to examples).
- [ ] schedule 30m with infra to discuss ephemeral GPU staging envs (Tues 11am?)

PERSONAL:
- pick up dry cleaning after 6pm
- call dentist (recall appt window)
- dinner: try the new bollywood place on 5th — check reviews first

NOTES / IDEAS:
- Quick experiment: measure token-per-second uplift w/ kv-cache prewarm for repeated session sims. Script idea: run 100 sessions with repeated prefixes, log latency delta.
- Draft message for onboarding email: keep under 5 bullets, add one gif? keep it minimal.

BLOCKERS:
- still waiting on infra access to dedicated-test pool (request ID INF-442). If not resolved today, reroute tests to local emulator.

RANDOM REMINDERS:
- backup phone photos to cloud (set nightly)
- check if open PR has perf benchmark attached — if not ask author to add small trace.

END quick notes. Will clean up and move to proper doc later.
